title: Salesforce OAuth access token in a token response member or Bearer header
summary: A synthetic OAuth access token as the access_token member of a web server flow token response, and after the Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of a REST API request, in a quoted curl argument and a raw request.
rationale: Salesforce documents the access token as the access_token parameter of the token response (token_type Bearer) and shows REST API requests sending it after Bearer in an Authorization header. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width, so the member name or the scheme is the only identifying context and no bare-value rule is implied. The Bearer scheme is generic, so the attribution stays generic. Whether a connected app token differs from an external client app token is not stated, so no subtype is claimed. The consumer key and instance URL are not the token.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value of the access_token member of a token response, and the value after an explicit Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of a Salesforce REST API request, are treated as a credential. Salesforce documents the member and the header example (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and generic attribution are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: access_token OAuth token that an external client app uses to request access to a protected resource on behalf of the client application. Additional permissions in the form of scopes can accompany the access token.
